title: Research audit: kernel102 packing ceiling holds without fallback charges
head: 4e53da28f56c46ecf48614b54f165453f3b48a87
body:
PR525's fixed kernel102 packing ceiling still holds after removing every positive fallback charge: the ideal rank moment alone exceeds one. This adds a standalone exact proof of that stronger cost statement, using two small pinned inputs and neither upstream moment engine.

- Enumerates all 112 packing patterns, with exact rational log/exp lower bounds and no solver or third-party dependencies.
- Verifies a dual whose minimum slack exceeds `2/10^11`; its ideal-moment lower bound exceeds `1 + 7/10^10` at `b = 6981767/5000000000`.
- Includes the weak-duality proof, exact deterministic result, source SHA-256/Git blob pins, and semantic negative controls that bypass file hashes.

The numerical ceiling is unchanged: under the original outer relation, `kappa < 6981767/5006981767`. The frozen local profile, helper widths, idle stocks, whole-helper assignment and paid-remainder model are explicit hypotheses. This does not reconstruct PR525's supplier, improve the selected frontier, or close its scalar/physical/all-size obligations.

Validation in a network-disabled, read-only Python container: `python -B verify.py`, plus 10 tests (26 negative cases) normally and under `-O`. An additional Codex review independently corroborated the inequalities using exact alternating Mercator/Taylor arithmetic; this is not human review or a Lean proof. No full supplier replay or GitHub CI result is claimed.

Reproduce from `research/kernel102-ideal-dual-audit/`:

```sh
python -B verify.py
python -B -m unittest -v test_verify.py
python -O -B -m unittest -v test_verify.py
```

Base: `f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`. PR525 source head: `71acd0c35ee81de848316b3f2b4c3bd15b219c51`. The package can be copied and run outside the repository. Recent PRs were checked for overlap through #852.

Prepared by Chinmay (@chinmayarvind23) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Chafik Boukhalfa (@chafreaky) supplied the model, source profile, original dual and numerical ceiling in #525; the new contribution is independent arithmetic verification and removal of the fallback-charge assumption. Upstream notices and Apache-2.0 attribution are retained.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
